intradayUnavailable: Intraday data unavailable or served from cache.
noPosition: No position held for this symbol.
intradayPendingOpen: Intraday data is not available yet, market open is not confirmed

valuation.title: Valuation
valuation.trailingPEHint: Price to earnings: share price divided by the last 12 months earnings per share. The lower, the cheaper the stock relative to its profits. Not meaningful (n.m.) when the company is loss-making.
valuation.priceToBookHint: Price to book: share price divided by book value per share. Below 1, the stock trades under its equity.
valuation.trailingEpsHint: Earnings per share over the last 12 months.
valuation.marketCapHint: Total market value: share price times the number of shares.
valuation.priceToSalesHint: Price to sales: market cap divided by the last 12 months revenue.
valuation.enterpriseValueHint: EV: market cap plus net debt. The price to buy the whole company.
valuation.enterpriseToEbitdaHint: Enterprise value divided by EBITDA. Compares companies with different debt levels.
valuation.betaHint: Sensitivity to the market: 1 = moves like the market, above = more volatile.
valuation.floatSharesHint: Number of shares actually tradable (excluding controlling shareholders).

health.title: Financial health
health.verdictHint: Summary of profitability, debt and growth against fixed thresholds. Information only, not investment advice.
health.financialSectorHint: Bank or insurer: debt is part of the business, debt ratios are not rated.
health.disclaimer: Yahoo Finance data, for information only.
health.thresholdHigher: Green at {{good}} or more, red below {{weak}}.
health.thresholdLower: Green at {{good}} or less, red above {{weak}}.

metrics.returnOnEquityHint: Return on equity: net income divided by shareholders' equity.
metrics.profitMarginHint: Share of revenue left as net income.
metrics.operatingMarginHint: Share of revenue left after operating costs.
metrics.debtToEquityHint: Total debt relative to shareholders' equity.
metrics.currentRatioHint: Current assets divided by current liabilities.
metrics.grossMarginHint: Revenue minus cost of sales, as a share of revenue.
metrics.returnOnAssetsHint: Return on assets: net income divided by total assets.
metrics.quickRatioHint: Like the current ratio, excluding inventories.
metrics.freeCashflowHint: FCF: cash generated after investments, available for dividends, buybacks or debt reduction.

etf.title: Fund / ETF information
etf.feesHint: TER: fees taken every year from the fund's assets.
etf.turnoverHint: Share of the portfolio replaced each year. High turnover means hidden trading costs.

returns.title: Returns
returns.hint: Annualized beyond one year, dividends reinvested. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

risk.title: 3-year risk
risk.volatilityHint: Annualized standard deviation of returns: the higher, the more the fund fluctuates.
risk.sharpeHint: Return above the risk-free rate per unit of volatility. Above 1, risk was well rewarded.
risk.betaHint: Sensitivity to the benchmark index: 1 = tracks the index.
risk.alphaHint: Yearly outperformance beyond what beta would predict.
risk.rSquaredHint: Share of the fund's moves explained by its index. Close to 100%, the fund tracks the index closely.

splits.detected: {{ratio}} on {{date}} detected: your quantities before that date must be adjusted.
splits.explanation: After a split, Yahoo publishes divided prices and adjusted history while your transactions keep their original quantities, so the valuation looks wrong. Applying adjusts earlier transactions on read (quantity multiplied, price divided, amount unchanged) without changing what you entered. Ignore it if your quantities are already adjusted, for instance after an import made after the split.
splits.adjustedHint: Stock split applied: read as {{quantity}} shares at {{price}}.

statements.title: Financial statements
statements.empty: No data published for this period.

earnings.title: Quarterly results
earnings.legend: Hollow circle: consensus. Filled circle: reported, green when the consensus was beaten, red otherwise.

insights.title: Technical signals
insights.supportHint: Price level where buying tends to slow down a fall.
insights.resistanceHint: Price level where selling tends to slow down a rise.
insights.stopLossHint: Level below which the provider considers the bullish scenario invalid.
insights.disclaimer: Information provided by {{provider}} via Yahoo Finance, not investment advice.

dividendSustainability.title: Growth and sustainability
dividendSustainability.payoutHint: Share of earnings paid as dividends. Green up to {{good}}, red above {{weak}} or when the company makes a loss.
dividendSustainability.coverageHint: Free cash flow of the last fiscal year divided by dividends paid. Green from x{{good}}, red below x{{weak}}.
dividendSustainability.growthHint: Average annual growth rate of the dividend per share over the last 5 complete calendar years.
dividendSustainability.streakHint: Number of consecutive calendar years of dividend per share increases, up to last year.
dividendSustainability.source: Yahoo Finance data, for information only: not investment advice.
